         2026 SOYBEAN DELAYED PRICE

        Effective September 5, 2026 through August 31, 2027
Scott:
Soybean – Delayed Price (DP) Rates

Drop Charge: None
Rate: $0.09 per bushel per month
(Pro-rated daily at $0.003 per bushel per day)
Effective Period: From date of delivery through August 31, 2026

Van Wert:
Soybean – Delayed Price (DP) Rates

Drop Charge: None
Rate: $0.09 per bushel per month
(Pro-rated daily at $0.003 per bushel per day)
Effective Period: From date of delivery through August 31, 2026

Early Sale Exemption:
Soybeans sold within 10 calendar days of delivery will have all Delayed Price
charges waived.

🔔 Important Reminders

On August 31, any soybeans remaining in Delayed Price will be subject to
Upcoming Year New Rate Schedule.

All accrued DP charges will be billed to the patron's account on August 31
Yearly.

If you are utilizing Delayed Price and do not have a current agreement on
file, please request and return a completed agreement within 10 days of
delivery.

Note: Rates and policies are subject to change without notice due to market
conditions.
